name: Mention
label: Mention
description: An inline reference to an entity or a skill, with the menu that @ or / opens while typing and the tag it leaves in the message.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The character that opened the mention, drawn a step quieter than the name.

props.name: children
props.description: The name: a person, a file, a skill.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to list, already filtered and ordered.

props.name: activeId
props.description: The `id` of the highlighted item: the one Enter would choose.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: Fires with an item's `id` when the pointer moves onto it.

props.name: onSelect
props.description:
Fires with the item a person chose.
Note: this replaces the native `onSelect` text-selection event, which MentionMenu does not expose.

props.name: query
props.description: The text typed so far. The part of each label that matches it is drawn stronger.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown in place of the list when `items` is empty. Without it an empty menu renders nothing.

props.name: text
props.description: The plain text, exactly as it was typed or sent.

props.name: sources
props.description: The sources whose items count as mentions in this text.

MentionItem.description: One thing a person can reference: a teammate, a file, a skill.

MentionSource.description: Everything one trigger character opens: `@` for entities, `/` for skills.
